decisions.statement: The documents are the node's machine-config patch and then its storage documents.
A volume the node states is one user volume document.
A node stating an ephemeral disk has an ephemeral volume document as well.
The schematic id the install image points at is read from `TALOS_SCHEMATIC_ID`.
Nothing here writes the cluster's PKI.
The node is named as a word or after `--node`.
Naming the node twice is refused.
A node the node table does not name is the caller's mistake.
The cluster is the node's own.
The registry CA is read only where the cluster names a registry host.
A schematic id nothing states is a placeholder rather than a refusal.
The documents are reported where no output file is named.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.

definition: the command writing one Talos node's machine-config overlay documents
